root_cause.text: The recovery work handlers in mlx5e acquired the netdev instance lock before the devlink lock, reversing the required lock ordering (devlink → rtnl → netdev) and deadlocking with the device initialization path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description states "mlx5e_tx_err_cqe_work (acquires netdev lock) … -> devlink_health_report (acquires devlink lock => boom!)" and the fix moves `netdev_trylock` calls from the work handlers into the recovery functions (called after devlink lock is held) to enforce the correct order.
